tools.description: Returns the directory of companies with their report days, quarter slugs, whether a company brief exists, and which of the four report pages each quarter has (full or headline).

tools.name: get_estimates
tools.description: Returns headline sales and EPS (low, PricedIn base, high), YoY growth, company guidance and vs_outlook, margins, capex, FCF, and last release result across companies (<= 25 KB per page). Defaults to next_quarter + year_1 across all companies, or all 5 horizons when tickers or horizon="all" is given.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, get_release_review · Private data: get_track_record · Public sink: get_estimates, get_drivers, get_track_record, get_quarter_forecast, get_release_review, get_after_the_call, get_full_forecast.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, get_release_review · Private data: get_track_record · Public sink: get_estimates, get_drivers, get_track_record, get_quarter_forecast, get_release_review, get_after_the_call, get_full_forecast

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
